name: system-context
description: Evaluate and improve System Context Diagram drawings — one system, the actors around it, and what flows between them
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a BASIC_U.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build a system context diagram for a payment platform, showing the customer, the platform and the external card network
Build a C4 context diagram for a booking system with two actor types and two external systems
Build a system context diagram for a CRM showing its boundary and the external systems it exchanges data with
Build a system context diagram for an internal application that authenticates against an external identity provider
